note: The frozen half of OER-07. Nothing a submission says may move any number in this file. The verifier reads its own copy of it at grading time, and tests/Dockerfile refuses to build unless the two copies are byte-identical.

budget.note: FIXED in tokens, in forward and backward passes, and in optimizer steps. grad_accum is frozen at 1 so that every schedule is evaluated over exactly the same 3072 points. Every submission therefore costs the same FLOPs and very nearly the same wall clock.

init.note: Every run in this task starts from the same parameter tensors. The learning-rate schedule is the only thing that differs between two runs.

optimizer.note: FROZEN, and this is what makes this slot a schedule task rather than a recipe task. The four per-role PEAK learning rates, the moments, epsilon, the decay and the gradient clip are all fixed here and are identical for the shipped default, for the verifier's private reference and for every submission. What a submission supplies is the multiplier applied to these peaks at each of the 3072 steps -- the SHAPE of the step-size envelope over time -- and nothing else. A submission cannot raise or lower a peak; it can only decide when the run is allowed to be near it.
optimizer.peak_note: The peaks above were chosen during authoring as the largest per-role values at which the run stays finite under the least forgiving schedule in the space, a flat constant envelope with no warmup at all. That matters: it means the shipped default is a real training run and not a divergence, so the low anchor of the reward scale is a loss and not a refusal.

evaluation.metric: mean token-level cross-entropy in nats, lower is better
evaluation.note: The graded split is NOT in the agent image. environment/data/devset_slice.bin is a proxy cut from a different FineWeb training shard and is the agent's own yardstick; it is never the graded number.

data.format: FineWeb10B GPT-2 BPE. 1024-byte int32 header (magic 20240520, version 1, token count), then uint16 token ids.
data.train_slice_note: Exactly the 25165824 tokens the budget consumes, plus one for the shifted target.
